exclusion_rationale: The three components contain 16,364 of 23,214 version-10 records and dominate different provisional splits.
Their generic IMG/frame/web filename families do not recover original capture-session identity.
Keeping them would make nominal sample size much larger than defensible source diversity and could confound model comparison with source-domain differences.
retention_policy: Retain approved background negatives because they measure false-alert resistance; negative does not mean false or erroneous.
Retain only records already present in annotation-adjudicated version 10.
Select at most 50 records per retained group by deterministic SHA-256 rank.
Assign whole groups to new 70/15/15 splits with seed 20260729; no version-10 test status is inherited or claimed.
known_limitations: Filename-derived groups remain proxies for original capture sessions.
The 50-record cap is an engineering choice to limit source dominance, not a statistically optimized threshold.
The candidate requires fresh duplicate, annotation, source-diversity, and visual audits before split freeze.
